build_DDPLoss_wrapper: build a DDP-aware loss wrapper using DDPLoss with mean reduction for distributed training
create_DDPMTLoss_with_reduction: create a DDPMTLoss instance with per_structure reduction and a custom coefficient for multi-task learning
register_custom_loss: register a custom loss function like MAELoss or MSELoss using the registry decorator pattern
compute_L2NormLoss_for_forces: compute the L2 norm MAE loss for vector-valued force predictions using L2NormLoss
compute_PerAtomMAELoss: compute per-atom MAE loss normalized by atom count using PerAtomMAELoss for scalar targets
